sources.observations: Computer Trash recovery is calendar-specific and requires sufficient edit rights. Documented retention is 30 days, subject to permanent removal. Some recurring-event deletion scopes do not enter Trash. Restored creator events require new guest RSVPs; room availability can have changed. Suspicious invitations can also be routed to Trash.
sources.limits: Do not generalize the window or recoverability to other providers, all recurrence scopes or permanently deleted events. Restoring a record is not proof that prior attendance or resource arrangements remain valid. No live account inspected.

sources.observations: iCloud restores an earlier calendar version across devices and saves the current version first. Recent changes may be lost; sharing settings are erased. The page distinguishes existing invitation and cancellation notification behaviour rather than promising these messages replay.
sources.limits: Archived-version restoration is not a selected-event Trash equivalent and not a Cloud Calendars or local-calendar restore feature. No account or restore action performed.
